name: kernel-browser
description: Use Kernel (kernel.sh) cloud browsers as Claude Code's browser: saved logins in profiles, 1Password and hosted sign-in, safe parallel browsing, and hooks that tag, track and delete the browsers a session creates.

api_key.title: Kernel API key (optional)
api_key.description: Only for the cleanup hooks: deleting this session's leftover browsers when it ends and counting leftovers at start. Stored in the OS keychain. The Kernel MCP itself signs in with OAuth through /mcp. Falls back to KERNEL_API_KEY.

default_timeout_seconds.title: Suggested idle timeout (seconds)
default_timeout_seconds.description: The timeout the create guard suggests for new browsers. It counts idle time only; idle browsers cost nothing.

max_timeout_seconds.title: Maximum idle timeout (seconds)
max_timeout_seconds.description: Browser creates above this are sent back to the agent to resend with a lower timeout.

project.title: Kernel project (optional)
project.description: Project name or id the cleanup calls use (match the project your agent browsers run in).

cleanup_on_session_end.title: Delete leftover browsers when a session ends
cleanup_on_session_end.description: Deletes the browsers this Claude Code session created and did not delete, except ones tagged keep=after-session. Needs the API key.

check_leftovers_on_start.title: Count leftover browsers at session start
check_leftovers_on_start.description: One Kernel API call at session start (cached 10 minutes) to report browsers earlier Claude Code sessions left alive. Needs the API key.
